answer: Audited claim bonds. Each claim about umber pigment purity, gale wind speed, or echo delay must lock a separate bond until its audit window closes. The verifier checks random claims against authenticated measurements and confiscates the bond for proven fabrication. N simultaneous claims require N locked bonds; one deposit cannot back several accounts. Choose the audit probability and bond so expected forfeiture exceeds the reward for lying. This assumes reliable ground truth and unpredictable audits; corrupt measurement sources defeat it.
